posts.author: Kaveh
posts.content_md: He moved to Photonix Imaging in Canada, but things didn't work out for some reason. Word has it he is back in France.

posts.author: Tom B.
posts.content_md:
> **Kaveh:** He moved to Photonix Imaging in Canada, but things didn't work out for some reason. Word has it he is back in France.

That's what I had figured, but I was curious about what this latest move is all about. My motive is simple - I'm running low on BB-plates and would like to finally give Ultimate plates a try before buying more BB plates. The recent price rise to $160 U.S for 10 4X5's (from $125) for BB plates seemed totally excessive and I thought a bit of consumer revolt was in order. I loved Yves' film (mostly), but was always too cheap to try his plates. It's damned inconvenient that he should choose this moment to rearrange his business

posts.author: floh
posts.content_md: When i asked about Bleach last month, Yves Gentet told me he is very busy. Wait one or two more weeks for an answer.
